bottom_line: The Therma-Tru Classic-Craft Premium represents a well-engineered fiberglass door with strong thermal performance (U-factors 1.19-1.70) and comprehensive warranty coverage (lifetime slab, 10-year finish), but faces significant durability concerns in field applications. Professional contractor reports document finger-jointed pine jamb failures within years of installation, contradicting 'rot-resistant' marketing claims. Multiple cases of thermal expansion failures behind storm doors and rapid deterioration (5-month timeline in one BBB complaint) raise questions about real-world durability. While the door features quality components like multi-point locking and ball-bearing hinges, the gap between marketing promises and field performance, combined with warranty exclusions for common installation scenarios, suggests careful evaluation of installation context and realistic maintenance expectations.
